verdict.rationale: Sketch's AI page documents AI-driven suggestions produced on the user's own content, such as complementary named color palettes from a dropped-in photo, context-aware replacement text, and automatic layer sorting and renaming. These are delivered through a built-in MCP server that the user's own AI client (ChatGPT, Claude) connects to, rather than a native in-product insights engine. missing for 10: native in-product AI insight or analysis of design data, documented suggestion/insight UI within Sketch, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Drop in a photo and get a full set of named color variables that complement it. An instant color palette, ready to use in your document.
Replace placeholder text across every layer with true-to-life, context-aware content.
Sketch includes a built-in MCP Server, a lightweight local-only web server that lets AI clients like ChatGPT or Claude interact directly with Sketch.
Connect any MCP-compatible AI client you like to Sketch.
